'''bounty hunter6 My Lord Is This Legal 5.0 a.k.a. I think I've lost count''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[bounty hunter6]]
* '''Published:''' 8 December 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal?|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' My Lord, Is That Legal?
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Legal hunter6 DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]
